fusions.name: Sounding Shriek
fusions.desc: Looses a shriek 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 10 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nip and Wheel
fusions.desc: A passing bite that deals 4 damage, heals you for 25% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after each bite.

fusions.name: Under the Eaves
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Night Feeder
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
